definition: Neighbourhood key — subdivision when available, else neighborhood.
Total short-term-rental listings in the neighbourhood.
Listings active in any of the last 12 months.
Share of listings owned by commercial+super-commercial hosts (>=5 listings).
Listings owned by hosts with >=2 listings.
Median TTM average daily rate in EUR/GBP.

Mean l90d_occupancy across listings in the neighbourhood. Defaults to 0.0 when AirDNA reports no occupancy data for any listing (only happens in tiny peripheral subdivisions; cross-check tier_sample_adequate before drawing conclusions).
Sum of TTM revenue across all listings (local currency).
Entire-home listings with ttm_days_booked > 90 — listings impacted at a 90-night cap.
Entire homes without a registration on record. Regulatory signal for Barcelona (RESIDE) — for London it's context only, not a breach.
Share of professionally-managed listings, computed only over listings where the field was reported (avoids null-imputation bias).
Policy-advisor risk tier (mentor update). tier_1 = top-quartile str_density AND median_nightly_price (per city); tier_2 = top-quartile in one; tier_3 = neither.
True if str_density >= 5; below that, the tier label is set to tier_3 but should be presented with a caveat.
